description: Claim a GitHub issue by posting a comment expressing intent to work on it. WARNING: posts a public comment under the authenticated user's identity. Irreversible. Do not call without explicit user confirmation. The server shows the user the comment and posts only after they approve; refused when the host cannot show that form, and in unattended runs.

issueUrl.description: Full GitHub issue URL to claim

message.description: Custom claim message. If omitted, a default message is used.

name: claim
